name: training
title: Training / explainer
description: Training session or explainer: objectives, concepts one per slide, a process, worked examples, a check for understanding and a summary; the script lives in the speaker notes.
storyline: Tell them what they will learn, teach one idea per slide with an example, check, then summarise. Put the spoken script in the notes, not on the slide.

slots.title: <Topic>: <what the learner will be able to do>
What you will be able to do
slots.guidance: 3-5 learning objectives, each starting with a verb.

slots.title: <One idea, stated as a sentence>
slots.guidance: One concept per slide, 3-4 short points; the explanation in the notes.

slots.title: <A worked example>
slots.guidance: Left: the situation; right: what to do and why.

slots.title: <The model that ties it together>
slots.guidance: A cycle, pyramid or 2x2 that organises the concepts.

slots.title: <The three things to remember>
slots.guidance: The key points, mirroring the objectives.
